caption:
"I renewed my passport. What happens to my visa?" It depends on the country — and the answer matters at the gate.

Some visas remain valid in the old passport and you carry both. Some permissions are linked digitally and the link must be updated. Get it wrong and you can be stopped at boarding with a perfectly valid visa.

Check before you book, not at the airport.

slides.headline: "I RENEWED MY PASSPORT. WHAT HAPPENS TO MY VISA?"
slides.sub: It depends. And it matters at the gate.
slides.note: This is one of the most common ways a valid visa still fails to get someone on a plane.

slides.body: Some visas stay valid in the old passport and you travel with both. Some permissions are linked digitally and that link has to be updated.
slides.note: There is no universal rule, which is exactly why people get caught out.

slides.headline: WHAT TO CONFIRM BEFORE YOU BOOK
items: Whether the visa stays valid in the expired passport
Whether you must carry both documents
Whether a digital record needs your new passport number
Whether the airline will accept the combination at check-in

slides.headline: A VALID VISA IS NOT ALWAYS A USABLE VISA.
